checks.why: a TypeScript decoration is recorded as a DECORATOR_CALL and nowhere else, so @Get had to be answered from the call sites — an empty decorations table read as 'this repository has no handler'
a decoration on the TYPE is carried by every method it declares, or the class-level form of every framework (@Controller, @RestController, @Injectable, @Component) answers nothing
a decoration that nothing carries still names the ones that exist, so the reader asks the next question with a real name
